tool.name: rgoslin - Lipid Shorthand Name Parsing and Normalization
tool.description: parses and normalizes lipid shorthand names across all dialects

param.name: input
param.label: Lipidomics Table
param.help: Upload a tabular containing lipid shorthand names.

param.name: lipid_column
param.label: Lipid Name Column
param.help: Select the column containing lipid shorthand names.

tool.help:
**What it does**
`rgoslin` parses and normalizes lipid shorthand nomenclature according to the **Grammar of Succinct Lipid Nomenclature (Goslin)** framework.
**Input**
A tabular file containing a column of lipid names.
**Output** It attempts to parse lipid names across multiple lipid nomenclature dialects (Goslin, SwissLipids, LIPID MAPS, HMDB, Shorthand2020, and FattyAcids) and uses the first successful parsing result. The outputs are **two datasets**:
1. **Summary Annotations:** Contains core metadata fields (`Normalized.Name`, `Grammar`, `Lipid.Maps.Category`, `Lipid.Maps.Main.Class`, `Species.Name`, `Total.C`, `Total.DB`, `Mass`, `Sum.Formula`). 2. **Full Annotations:** Contains all 50+ structural and fatty acid position level details.
